newsitem.title: THAILAND: Death toll in Thai oil depot blast rises to 15.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Thai oil depot blast rises to 15.

text.p: The death toll in a bunker oil depot explosion in Thailand's eastern Rayong province rose to 15 as rescue workers on Friday retrieved three more charred bodies from the scene, officials said.

Police had said after the blast occurred late on Thursday that 12 people were killed and several others might have been trapped in the depot fire which lasted more than five hours after the initial explosion.
They added that 10 others, including women and children, were in hospital with injuries and in stable condition.

Police said they were investigating the cause of the blast and looking for the depot owners, Rungmeesap Petroleum Ltd Partnership, to determine if a house had been illegally converted into an underground depot.
Police estimated that the depot stored about three million litres of oil, most of it in underground tanks, at the time of the blast.
